sources.title: MiniMax-H3 - SGLang Documentation
sources.snippet: MiniMax-H3 is a native joint video-and-audio model for text-to-video-and-audio, first/last-frame control, and multimodal reference conditioning. Its main strength is producing the picture and stereo soundtrack together, so speech, music, ambient sound, and visible events can stay aligned without a separate audio-generation pass.
